_source: Placement library (4/N). Gochar alerts keyed "{Planet}:{houseFromMoon}". Replaces the HARDCODED ENGLISH transit strings the gochar path used, which were untranslatable by construction. Covers the Saturn Sade Sati / Ardha Kantaka / Ashtama Shani cycle plus Jupiter, Rahu and Ketu positions that classical texts flag. Payload { text, tone }. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=transit-alert`.

en.text: Sade Sati begins — Saturn enters the 12th from your Moon. Expenses, sleep and endurance are tested; simplify rather than expand.
The peak of Sade Sati — Saturn over your Moon. Heaviest emotionally; it rewards patience and punishes shortcuts.
The closing phase of Sade Sati — Saturn in the 2nd from your Moon. Pressure on finances and family speech, easing as it completes.
Ardha Kantaka (small panoti) — Saturn in the 4th from your Moon. Domestic and property matters demand attention.
Ashtama Shani — Saturn in the 8th from your Moon. A demanding transit; avoid unnecessary risk and attend to health.
Saturn in the 3rd from your Moon — one of its best positions. Sustained effort now produces disproportionate results.
Saturn in the 6th from your Moon — strong for defeating competition, clearing debt and building discipline.
Saturn in the 11th from your Moon — steady gains and the maturing of long-held goals.
Jupiter in the 2nd from your Moon — favourable for wealth, family and speech.
Jupiter in the 5th from your Moon — excellent for children, learning and creative merit.
Jupiter in the 7th from your Moon — supportive for marriage, partnership and agreements.
Jupiter in the 9th from your Moon — fortune, travel and guidance arrive readily.
Jupiter in the 11th from your Moon — gains and fulfilled desires.
Jupiter over your Moon — optimism rises; guard against over-commitment and weight.
Jupiter in the 3rd from your Moon — effort exceeds reward for a while; keep expectations modest.
Jupiter in the 6th from your Moon — obstacles need active management; health deserves attention.
Rahu over your Moon — restlessness and unusual desires; decisions made now deserve a second look.
Rahu in the 3rd from your Moon — bold initiative pays off; courage is amplified.
Ketu over your Moon — detachment and a pull inward; good for spiritual work, poor for negotiation.
